# Dijup Tuladhar

> Senior Product Designer, AI UX Strategist & Fractional Design Leader. 20+ years crafting AI-enabled products, design systems, healthcare UX, and design-led agility frameworks. Based in Kathmandu, Nepal, working globally. Founder of Chordpedia, Nepal's largest guitar chords and music platform.

## Summary
Dijup Tuladhar is a Senior Principal Product Designer, AI UX strategist, fractional design leader, and entrepreneur with over two decades of experience bridging design excellence, AI product strategy, and agile execution. He is the founder and full-stack builder of Chordpedia, Nepal's flagship music chords and lyrics platform, scaling it organically to over 82,000 users and 400+ active musicians. At Cotiviti and Infinite Computer Solutions, he has spearheaded design systems and UX architecture for multi-million-dollar healthcare analytics and clinical intelligence platforms.

## Core Expertise
- **AI UX Design**: Designing agentic workflows, LLM prompt interfaces, generative AI product design, and human-in-the-loop AI systems.
- **Fractional Product Design Leadership**: Embedded fractional design leader for startups and enterprise teams — design systems architecture, AI UX strategy, and rapid discovery sprints.
- **Design-Led Agility**: Integrating Design Sprints with SAFe 5 and Scrum engineering sprints to eliminate waste and accelerate product-market fit.
- **Enterprise Design Systems**: Multi-brand Figma token architectures synchronized with React and React Native codebases. Figma design system architect.
- **Healthcare UX & Clinical Interface Design**: HIPAA-compliant interfaces, clinical data visualization, EHR UX design, and progressive disclosure for high-cognitive-load environments.
- **Full-Cycle Product Building**: Hands-on architecture with React, TypeScript, React Native, PHP, MySQL, and Web Audio APIs.
- **Product Designer Nepal / Kathmandu**: Based in Kathmandu, Nepal — available globally for remote fractional design leadership and AI product consulting.

## Ventures & Leadership
- **Chordpedia** (https://chordpedia.com): Founder & Developer. Bootstrapped Nepal's largest guitar & ukulele chords platform. 82,000+ users. Facebook FbStart recipient. Nepal music platform founder.
- **Infinite Computer Solutions**: Senior Principal Product Designer (2024–Present), leading global enterprise product design and AI UX workflows.
- **Cotiviti** (formerly D2Hawkeye / Verscend): Sr. Principal Creative Designer (2008–Present), 16+ years designing clinical intelligence and healthcare analytics platforms.
